svg.title: Driftless Star workflow
svg.desc: Horizontal rendition of the supplied figure, retaining its wording. The input box contains a still frame of the supplied stellarator boundary animation. Inputs lead to Equilibrium with VMEX, Orbit Confinement with booz_xform, parallel Neoclassical Transport with DKX and sfincs and Turbulent Transport with GKX and GX, then Global Transport with NEOPAX. The return arrow reads, New pressure is fed back as new input until convergence.

image.aria-label: Stellarator boundary from the supplied GIF

svg.text: New pressure is fed back as new input until convergence.
